name: Bangkok Dusit Medical Services Public Company Limited
summary: Bangkok Dusit Medical Services Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates hospitals in Thailand and internationally. It operates through two segments Hospital Operations; and Other Businesses That Support Hospital Business. The company operates hospitals under the Bangkok Hospital Group, Samitivej Hospital Group, BNH Hospital, Phyathai Hospital Group, Paolo Hospital, and Royal Hospital Group names; and BDMS Wellness Clinic.
